q: The mechanism is genuinely silent — our clients reach for the remote expecting a whir and there is nothing. It changed how we spec seating.
We white-labelled an entire power-recliner range with Climate Craft. Delivered to spec, on the promised date, every single order.
Two thousand fabrics, digitised and colour-accurate. Our showroom finally matches what the client sees on screen.
The build quality is on another level. Hand-tied suspension, hardwood frame — it sits as beautifully as it looks in the room.
